task: Describe tu ciudad o barrio en 5 frases usando there is / there are.
paragraphs: I live in Hayfield, a small town in the north of England. It's a quiet and beautiful place, with hills all around it.
In the town centre there is a supermarket, a post office, two pubs and a small library. There isn't a cinema, but there is a big cinema in the next town. There are three schools and a train station.
My house is on Station Road, next to the bakery. Every morning, the street smells of fresh bread! Opposite my house there is a park with a river.
I like my town because the people are friendly and there are lots of places for walking. But at night it's very quiet. There isn't a lot to do!
